determinism.detail: Identical-input Fly-To-and-Orbit runs differ ONLY in settings.name and environmentGroup.sunGroup.worldTime min/maxValueRange (wall-clock epoch ms). Every camera keyframe time/value/transition is bit-identical. Exact fitting is licensed.

geodesic_basis.rule: Template distances are exact on a sphere of radius 6378137 m (WGS84 equatorial). Haversine on R=6371000 reproduces all constants with a uniform 0.11% deficit; on R=6378137 the constants are exact (624.0, 2000.0, 20000.0).

altitude_encoding.linear_model: animationModel.logarithmic=false (orbit, spiral, fly-to-and-orbit): stored keyframe value = (alt_m + 500) / 65117981; interpolation in that linear space.
altitude_encoding.logarithmic_model: animationModel.logarithmic=true (zoom-to, point-to-point): stored keyframe value = ((alt_m + 500) / 65117981)^(1/15); alt_m = -500 + 65117981 * norm^15. Exponent 15 verified to 0.3 m over the full 65,117 km span (EXACT_NATIVE_CONSTANT). Interpolation and transition handles operate in the power-15 space — this IS the perceptual zoom curve.

global_findings.rotation_authoring: Templates author camera rotation exclusively through cameraTargetEffect look-at (orbit/spiral/fly-orbit, influence 1) or leave pan/tilt untouched at 0/0 with influence 0 (zoom-to, point-to-point). No template writes pan/tilt keyframes.
global_findings.inspector_defect: scripts/inspect-earth-studio-project.js linear-denormalizes altitude regardless of animationModel.logarithmic; zoom-to/point-to-point dump altitudes are wrong in meters (raw norms correct). Gate 3 must fix or account for this. Frozen Gate 1 dumps intentionally left as captured.

geometry.tilt_rule: no tilt keyframes; look-at via cameraTargetEffect influence 1 yields tilt = atan(radius / (camera_alt - target_alt)); verified: atan(624/312)=63.435° vs observed 63.432-63.444; atan(2497/311.7)=82.88° vs observed 82.875

start_position_law.horizontal: start at azimuth = approach_angle − 90°·orbit_sign (orbit_sign=+1 clockwise, −1 counterclockwise); distance = orbit_radius + 20,000 m (EXACT on R=6378137; verified radius 400->20,400 and radius 800->20,800)

start_position_law.geometry_note: equal 20,000 m horizontal and vertical offsets give the observed ≈45° initial look-at tilt: atan((radius+20000)/20000) = 45.25° @ r=400 (observed 45.205), 46.1°... B: atan(20800/20736)=45.09° (observed 45.01); tilt is pure look-at DERIVED_GEOMETRIC
